title: TriadicFrameworks MCP — Analyzer Layer Resolver
description: Resolves the analyzer layer for a given operator, diagnostic, or resonance primitive within the Frequency Layer.
note: Students may rename qmroot if extending the work; it is a lineage artifact for TriadicFrameworks and RTT.

tool.name: getAnalyzerLayer
tool.purpose: Determine the analyzer layer (L0–L3) for a given entity.

entity.description: Name or ID of the operator, diagnostic, or resonance primitive.

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include metadata about the resolved layer.

layer.description: Resolved analyzer layer (e.g., L0_QMROOT, L1_Frequency_Unseen, L2_Fluids_Seen, L3_Forces_Unseen).

metadata.description: Coherence is a spectral diagnostic belonging to the Frequency Layer.

reality.details: Layer is resolved using diagnostic → layer mapping rules.

imagination.details: The unseen resonance field reveals the structural tier where the entity resides.

information.details: Layer resolution inherits qmroot-0D and triad-frequency metadata for cosmological consistency.
